sources.notes: Fetched. Verbatim: 'The questions are randomised but will typically cover:' followed by the six topics. Pre-CAS Interview (PCI) is 'a short, self-recorded video interview completed online through CAS Shield'; passport shown to camera; 'The interview takes around 20 to 25 minutes to complete depending on the length of your responses.' Required for students from 'Algeria, Angola, Bangladesh, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ghana, Kenya, India, Malawi, Nepal, Nigeria, Sri-Lanka, Syria, Uganda, Zimbabwe'. 'A minimum payment of £1,000 is required in advance', remaining £4,000 after passing. Outcomes verbatim: 'Pass: You have demonstrated a genuine intention to study at LJMU and we believe you can meet the Student visa requirements.' 'Resit: Your interview is borderline, and you have been offered one chance to resit.' 'Fail: We have concerns about your intention to study at LJMU or your ability to make a successful visa application.' 'We will review your recording and aim to give you an outcome within three to four working days.' No notes/scripts allowed; pre-prepared answers may result in failing.

No questions.

sources.title: Liverpool John Moores University: live CAS Shield tenant (ljmu.cas-shield.com)
sources.notes: Probed 8 September 2026: the subdomain answers HTTP 200 with the Enroly CAS Shield sign-in page (random subdomains answer nothing), so the university runs its CAS process through Enroly. CAS Shield interviews follow the themes in Brunel's published policy; whether this university switches the interview on for every Nepali applicant is not stated here.

searchesRun: Liverpool John Moores University credibility interview questions
researcherNotes: LJMU's official PCI page is the strongest official source in this group: names Nepal explicitly, confirms CAS Shield, randomised questions from six themes, and pass/resit/fail rules.
